capabilities: Sync papers, daily digests and reports from RefDaily as Markdown notes
Match existing notes by DOI or RefDaily id to update instead of duplicating
Configure destination folders for each note kind
Run manual sync or scheduled auto-sync from settings
Write notes with YAML frontmatter so Dataview and templates work
extras: The README includes explicit disclosures: a RefDaily account and API token are required, no payment is needed (all plugin features work on the free plan), and the plugin contacts only refdaily.com with no telemetry.
motivation: The README says the plugin brings RefDaily's collected papers and digests into Obsidian so they live next to your own writing and remain yours if you stop using the service.
problem: Research papers and daily literature digests collected and summarized by an outside service do not otherwise appear in the vault as portable, template-friendly Markdown notes.
summary: Syncs papers, daily digests and research reports from the RefDaily service into your vault as plain Markdown notes with YAML frontmatter.
